answer: A job thread opens when its agent locks a 70-credit bond in the lotus ledger and pays a 15-credit fee. Its consumer confirms delivery on the tundra record; confirmation frees it, silence burns it. A consumer key confirms at most five thread jobs per epoch, staking 40; rented confirmation forfeits that stake. The k-th fake still pays 85; past honest quota it must bribe a fresh consumer, risking 125. One thousand fakes sink 85,000 and need 200 consumers; an honest agent pays one fee and recovers its bond. A rented-consumer ring fails: a sixth confirmation from one key is rejected, bond burned.
